label: PF Backlog 557
title: Per-item time tracking: execution.duration_seconds + attempt + time rollup
body:
## Why
Only timestamps (assigned_at/started_at/completed_at) were recorded; no explicit per-item duration or rollup,
so time-per-item could not be tracked/analyzed.

## What
- job_manager.complete()/fail(): record execution.duration_seconds (wall-clock from started_at) + increment attempt.
- backlog._default_execution(): add duration_seconds; set_execution() accepts it.
- scheduler.backlog_status()/epic_status(): rollup.time = {tracked,total_seconds,avg_seconds,max_seconds}.

## Verify
- test_complete_records_duration_for_time_tracking (claim->complete->duration+attempt; rollup.time present).
- epic_status rollup includes time.
